title: Taking a Position: Stance Adverbs
goal: Open and place stance adverbs such as evidentemente and a todas luces to take a clear position in an editorial.

items: I can open a sentence in an editorial with a stance adverb such as *evidentemente* or *a todas luces*.
I can set a stance adverb between commas and use *evidentemente*, not the adjective *evidente*, as a comment on the sentence.
I can show how sure I am with *sin duda*, *evidentemente* and *francamente*.
